I will do this plot much like last season because money is tight and this land is rented, so I do not want to put too much cash there. If I get a little fertilizer money, I will buy one small share with another farmer and put it on the maize, but I will not buy chemicals for weeds or pests, and I will wait for the rains because I have no irrigation. I will use local seed that I know, and most of the work I will do with my family.
